items.title: Payment Channels: 1 Million Payments Per Second
items.whyYouShouldCare: The ability to process 1 million payments per second positions Solana as a leading platform for high-volume transactions, enhancing its liquidity and ecosystem usage.

items.title: What Solana’s failed fee vote reveals about Anatoly Yakovenko’s power
items.whyYouShouldCare: The failed fee vote highlights the concentration of power within Solana's leadership, potentially impacting governance and future decision-making processes.

items.title: This Japanese company made money on Ethereum, Solana, and XRP, but sold them anyway to keep its $121 million Bitcoin holdings
items.whyYouShouldCare: The decision to liquidate holdings in Ethereum, Solana, and XRP while retaining Bitcoin suggests a strategic focus that may influence market perceptions of Solana's value.
